verdict.rationale: Datadog ships a dedicated Cloud Cost Management product (datadog-docs-15) that vendor docs describe as attributing cloud spend and surfacing usage trends, which is the closest fit to this story, but there is no evidence of built-in visibility into Datadog's *own* usage/billing per team or proactive spike alerts on the Datadog bill itself. A concrete community report explicitly cites 'Lack of billing transparency' as a reason a large customer (~$6M/yr) left Datadog, directly contradicting the idea that SREs can easily see and attribute their observability spend before surprise bills. Missing for 10: first-party docs/evidence of per-team/service cost attribution specifically for Datadog usage (not just underlying cloud costs), proactive spend-spike alerting, and independent confirmation that billing transparency concerns have been resolved.
